decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external works hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans PO1, P02, and P03 submitted 17 September 2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8:00am  to 6:00pm on Mondays to Friday and 9 :00am to 1:00pm on Saturdays and none shall take place on Sundays and Public Holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - The roof area of the building shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 6 - The external staircase hereby approved shall to be used soley as a means of escape, and to provide access to the roof for maintenance purposes.
description: Replacement roof incorporating PV panels, rooflights and ventilation cowls. Alterations to main facade - external insulation with render, new windows, alteration of door to a window and alteration of access roller shutter into glazed entrance.  Addition of solar canopy to south facing windows and timber canopy to entrance.  Addition of means of escape stair case to two storey office.
